limits: Supply enumeration and chassis power budget are software observations, not voltage/current measurements or functional PoE.
Byte 4/controller presence was deliberately retained from the real status result; no controller/daughter presence spoof or arbitrary register write was attempted.
Zero status flags do not distinguish absent, unsupported, misdetected or failed circuitry. Empty J3300 in historical A photos does not establish its function or rule out integrated circuitry.
No extended traffic, power-delivery, electrical safety or endurance validation was performed.
The prior crashing native test platform hardware poe get 0 global command was not repeated.

No ROMMON sync, saved-config command, package/firmware/EEPROM write, TPM clear, fuse or provisioning change was requested or performed. Native startup/logging/crash-report writes occurred; this is not a claim of zero storage writes.
The V1 crash system report RP_0-system-report_20250529-184935-Universal.tar.gz (90782 KB) remains on the router; no core bundle was downloaded or published in this experiment.
Credential/pattern checks cannot prove absence of every unknown secret in binary data. Full source/candidate/vendor-script copies and raw console remain local.
next_step: With the chassis assembled, continue static Arata controller/presence-path analysis and reference-hardware correlation to identify the actual byte-4 source and qualified controller interface before another targeted runtime test. Do not repeat the known crashing diagnostic get.
